opening.argument: The material presents a practical contributor onboarding workflow: create a Picxy account, upload photographs, and configure a method for receiving payments. The tutorial states, “In this you can drag and drop your image here. You can click here to upload it,” then explains that “the more images you sell, the more profit you get.” It also directs users to add bank or PayPal details, while the visible upload guidance includes conditions such as submitting images without watermarks. Joining bonuses, referral codes, password setup, and payout setup appear alongside these ordinary instructions and review requirements, without evidence here of deception or an unsupported transaction outcome.
